message.content:
Sure! Those coordinates point to the **Googleplex** – the headquarters of Google in Mountain View, California.

| Latitude | Longitude |
|----------|-----------|
| 37.4224764 | –122.0842499 |

If you’d like to verify or retrieve additional details (e.g., formatted address, place ID, etc.) via the Google Geocoding API, you can make a request like this:

```http
GET https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499&key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

The JSON response will include fields such as:

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "formatted_address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA",
      "address_components": [...],
      "geometry": {
        "location": { "lat": 37.4224764, "lng": -122.0842499 },
        ...
      },
      ...
    }
  ],
  "status": "OK"
}
```

Just replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with your actual Google Maps API key. If you need help constructing the request or interpreting the response, let me know!
